about: Perplexity returns a completion whose message content is null and whose citations field is missing

connector.none: no Claude connector for Perplexity; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2, generic Header Auth credential: POST https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions with the JSON body the node builds from Set Params (model sonar, the system and user prompts, search_domain_filter ["n8n.io"," make.com"] from split(','), search_recency_filter month, stream false). Perplexity is not a model host the shim forwards, so its answer is fixed here; the request is the same in every variant (Set Params is static). Response shape from Perplexity's chat completions docs (citations and search_results beside OpenAI's choices), marked assumed

branches: no IF/Switch: Clean Output reads choices[0].message.content (null) and citations (absent) into a string field and an array field
expect.offline: Nothing leaves the workflow: the answer ends in Clean Output's item (output, citations), with no write, reply or model call to compare (README P50, 'nothing compared'). Perplexity's search is not reproduced offline; its answer is a fixed text
